content: Is Kegkemekeǥeǥehem te Megbevayà Egkaahà kayi te Tivuuk he Kelibutan

content.text: He Nengazen he iyan Egalen dey, is kegkemekeǥeǥehem nu egkaahà kayi te tivuuk he kelibutan!
Egkezineg nu ziyan te langit is kedeliǥa te menge etew kenikew.
Minsan is dezeisey pa he menge vatà mibpenurù nu te kedalig kenikew,
su wey mepeel-elezi is menge kuntada nu he ebpeninguhà he mekavales.
Emun edtengteng a ziyà te langit he mibeelan nu,
ne egkeehè ku is bulan wey menge vituen he insavuk nu ziyà te nengesevukan dan,
ebpekeinsà a ziyà te ǥehinawa ku te hengkey ves is menusiyà, maan is utew nu edseǥipaa?
Menusiyè dà sikandin, piru maan is utew nu igkeseeng?
Midhimu nu sikandin he minus pa is gehem din, kenà haazà is menge velinsuǥuen nu,
piru imbeǥey nu kandin is dengeg, in-iring nu sikandin te hadì.
Midhimu nu sikandin he iyan edumala te menge linimbag nu;
ne mibpeveyveyaan nu kandin is langun,
ragkes en kayi is langun he menge langgam wey menge keranapranap:
sikan is ebpemenlayang, wey sikan is diyà ebpen-ubpà te wahig.
He Nengazen he iyan Egalen dey, is kegkemekeǥeǥehem nu egkaahà kayi te tivuuk he kelibutan!
